newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids remain weak.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Bids remain weak.

text.p: Dark northern spring wheat cash bids remained weaker on Tuesday, in tandem with lower MGE spring wheat futures. Soft white wheat values were also down.
MGE spring wheat futures lost 2-1/2 cents per bushel to settle at $4.45 a bushel basis December.
Basis levels were pressured by the ongoing harvest in parts of North Dakota. Also, dealers noted good receipts, backed by a favorable car count at Minneapolis for nearby spring wheat.
"Over 700 (rail) cars came in this morning," a dealer said.
In Montana, one dealer said the central part of the state completed harvesting of spring wheat.

But yields were down at around 20 to 25 bushels per acre compared to an average 40 bushels, he said. Test weights are about 58-60 lbs and could be better. Protein content is high at 13 percent or better.
